row.proto: bool Game_PitLane_ProjectBoxPose(void *mgr, void *out, void *mtx, uint32_t box, uint32_t flags)
row.notes: Single caller FUN_1434be460 (state 10/11 hold-in-garage alignment, from Game_PitLane_UpdateMovement 0x1434b919e) passes the pit lane record +0xe0 as box. Reads the cached spline handle at mgr+0x7f8+box*8 (40 slots, the per-car records start at mgr+0x938) with no bound on box: -1 (a third car in a garage has no box) or 99 faults at 0x1434c3656 (mov r8,[rbx+r14*8+0x7f8]). Returns false (setne al at 0x1434c4202, edi = 2) when the projection fails, and the caller then leaves the car alone. focus325 and simon_92216 1.6.12 crashes. Needs L2 promotion by the game owner.
